title: Background task completion, stable stamps, and remote switch polish
highlights: Cancelling a background task now publishes BackgroundTaskCompleted, so clients and transcripts see the task finish instead of waiting forever
Remote model and reasoning switches no longer print duplicate transcript messages, and the paced stream flushes immediately when the turn is done
improvements: Throttle and activity stamp files always carry a non-empty payload
Replay signed thinking when the Claude provider route resends history
Fork releases can point the installer smoke test at their own repository via JCODE_REPO
fixes: Flush the paced stream buffer on Done instead of deferring (net -45 lines)
